ownership.quote: Runpod, an AI app hosting platform that launched four years ago, has hit a $120 million annual revenue run rate, founders Zhen Lu and Pardeep Singh tell TechCrunch.

stage.quote: The Series A funding, led by Summit Partners, brings the company's total funding to $122 million across multiple rounds, including a seed round in May 2024 co-led by Intel Capital and Dell Technologies Capital.
stage.note: Bootstrapped 2021-2024 before any outside capital; first priced round was a $20M seed (May 2024), followed directly by a $100M Series A (June 2026) — no intermediate seed extension or bridge reported.

accelerators.quote: listed in the AI Grant portfolio as "RunPod"

total_funding_usd.basis: SiliconANGLE reporting on the Series A announcement states total funding of $122M across the seed and Series A rounds

last_round.quote: Artificial intelligence developer-centric cloud provider Runpod Inc. announced Wednesday that it has raised $100 million in early-stage funding, pushing the valuation of the company to $1 billion. The Series A funding, led by Summit Partners...

revenue.basis: Company press release; corroborated by TechCrunch
revenue.quote: Runpod ... today announced it has surpassed $120 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) ... revenue grew 90% YoY

note: Founded late 2021/early 2022 by Zhen Lu and Pardeep Singh (ex-Comcast developers) after repurposing Ethereum-mining rigs into GPU servers; grew via Reddit posts and revenue-share data-center deals, bootstrapping to ~$24M revenue before any VC money. Took a $20M seed co-led by Dell Technologies Capital and Intel Capital in May 2024 (angels incl. Nat Friedman and Hugging Face co-founder Julien Chaumond), then a $100M Series A led by Summit Partners in June 2026 at a $1B valuation. Surpassed $120M ARR (Jan 2026) serving 1M+ developers; customers include Replit, Cursor, OpenAI, Perplexity, Wix, Zillow.
